docs.title: Aperture 5.1: Environmental Acoustics & Rhythmic Entrainment (\(\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{acoustic}}\))
1. Epistemological & Physical Scope
docs.text:
Aperture 5.1 maps the physics of sound in the environment onto Spine \(\mathcal{T}\): the radiation of sound by sources; its reflection, scattering, and absorption by surfaces and objects; the reverberant field that builds up where sound is enclosed; and the relation between rhythmic sound and the timing of the organisms that hear it (rhythmic entrainment). Its empirical domain is the reverberant field in its diffuse regime. Acoustic power supplied by a source spreads through the air of an enclosure by repeated reflection and scattering, which at scales large against the mean free path of sound is a diffusion of acoustic energy, and is absorbed by the enclosure's surfaces and by the air. Lexicon is strictly restricted to physical acoustics, room and environmental acoustics, psychoacoustics, and the science of rhythm and timing.

Declaration (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3; Branch II).

  • Domain \(\mathcal{M}\) (\(n = 3\)) and boundary \(\partial\mathcal{M}\). The air of a closed, rigid enclosure (a test enclosure, a scale model, or any enclosed space that meets the preconditions below), unoccupied within windows, minus an excised source region: a closed region around the sound source and its mounting that contains the source's near field and every point within a declared number of mean free paths of the source, where the diffusion law does not hold. Diffuse reflection by the bounding surfaces and, where present, scattering by a uniform random distribution of small, fixed, rigid scatterers make the field diffuse; the scatterers are treated at the continuum scale as part of the medium, through \(\mathfrak{K}\) and the storage coefficient, and are not holes of \(\mathcal{M}\). \(\partial\mathcal{M}\) consists of:
  • the source surface (supply), the boundary of the excised region, across which the source's acoustic power enters \(\mathcal{M}\);
  • the bounding surfaces of the enclosure (outflow), which absorb part of the energy incident on them, in proportion to \(\mathcal{F}\) there (a Robin exchange, below), and transmit part to the outside.

Every part of the bounding surface absorbs (precondition 4): a perfectly reflecting part would be a zero-flux face, on which the normal derivative of \(\mathcal{F}\) vanishes. All supply crosses the source surface; the air contains no other source, and sound entering from outside is held below tolerance (precondition 1), so there are no interior sources. The excised region is either attached through its mounting to a bounding surface, so that its surface is a concave part of \(\partial\mathcal{M}\), or free-standing, an interior cavity whose surface \(\mathcal{M}\) surrounds and which is concave as seen from \(\mathcal{M}\). The source and its signal, the linings of the bounding surfaces (a different storage class, §0.1 item 3), and the space outside the enclosure lie outside \(\mathcal{M}\). * Window. A relaxation window (§0.1 item 1), opened from a prior steady state at a held non-zero source power by a declared step increase of that power, after which the source power, the temperature, humidity, and pressure of the air, and the state of the enclosure are held within tolerance. The source radiates stationary random noise filtered to the declared band, never a periodic, rhythmic, or modulated signal. Windows in which the source is switched off are excluded: the decay of the field after switch-off, from which reverberation time is measured, relaxes to the datum with no throughput, so it is not a Branch II window. It may serve as a declared perturbation regime before the window. * Metric. Flat and rigid (§0.1 item 2): \(g_{\mu u} = \delta_{\mu u}\) in a Cartesian chart, with the enclosure's volume, surveyed before and after the window, within the rigid tolerance. The vibration of the bounding surfaces is cyclic and is never \( heta\). * Cone speed. \(c_*\) is the speed of sound in the air at the declared temperature (§0.1 item 5). Drifts of the air are \(\ll c_*\), and in the diffusion regime the transport velocity of acoustic energy is \(\ll c_*\) (precondition 2). * Storage. \(s = \phi_{\mathrm{a}}\): the volume fraction of the enclosure's interior occupied by air, which is \(1\) without scatterers. It is declared uniform over \(\mathcal{M}\) within tolerance (§0.1 item 3), with the scatterers' number and volume taken from a survey of the enclosure. * Free energy \(\mathcal{F}\) and datum. \(\mathcal{F} = u\) (J m⁻³), the acoustic energy density of the air (kinetic plus potential) in a declared frequency band, averaged over a declared time \( au_{\mathrm{avg}}\) that is long against the reciprocal of the bandwidth and short against the relaxation time. \(u\) is already an energy density, so the declared yield is \(1\), and \(\mathcal{F}\) is the acoustic energy stored per unit volume times the declared conversion factor \(1/s\). This is the declared linear form of aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3 item 3: an incoherent diffuse field carries entropy, so its thermodynamic free energy is smaller than its energy, and \(\mathcal{F}\) is the energy density above the zero datum, not that free energy. The datum is zero (\(\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{ref}} = 0\), silence), and \(\mathcal{F} \ge 0\) holds trivially. The relaxation time \(\ell^2/D\) across the enclosure's extent \(\ell\) is finite and resolvable: it exceeds \( au_{\mathrm{avg}}\) and the mean free time \(\lambda/c_*\) by declared factors. * Transport \(\mathfrak{K}\). \(\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} = D\,g^{\alpha eta}\), with \(D = \lambda c_*/3\) the acoustic diffusion coefficient of the mean-free-path model (the medium's energy conductance over \(s\)). \(\lambda\) is the mean free path of sound in the enclosure, combining by the sum of reciprocals the enclosure's own mean free path (four times its volume over its bounding area) with the scattering mean free path set by the scatterers' number density and mean cross-section. \(D\) is uniform and isotropic, the default form of aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3 item 4, with its value declared: \(\lambda\) is estimated per closure (ii) from a geometric survey of the enclosure and its scatterers (a different modality), and \(c_*\) from the measured air temperature. With \(j\) the net acoustic intensity per unit bulk area (W m⁻²), \(J_W = j/s\), and \(1/s\) is the declared conversion factor. * Outflow boundary. At the bounding surfaces the outward normal component of \(J_W\) is \((A/s)\,\mathcal{F}\), with the exchange coefficient \(A = c_*\alpha/4\) of a diffusely reflecting surface of absorption coefficient \(\alpha\) (the low-absorption form, the default) or the declared modified form for larger \(\alpha\). \(\alpha\) is measured in situ on the enclosure's own surfaces before the window, by a pressure–velocity probe or an in-situ impedance method, in the declared band. The linings' own storage is neglected (precondition 3). * Supply boundary. After a short rise time, the net inflow across the source surface equals the source's acoustic power \(P\) within the flux tolerance: the source is omnidirectional within tolerance in the declared band, so the inflow is spread uniformly over the surface, and absorption within the excised region and the change of energy stored in it are below tolerance (precondition 7). \(P\) is the source's calibrated acoustic power at its held drive, measured on the source itself in a declared calibration regime before the window, a different modality from any measurement in the enclosure. * Sink \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}}\). Air absorption, first order relative to the datum: \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}} = k_{\mathrm{a}}\mathcal{F}\), with \(k_{\mathrm{a}} = m\,c_*\) and \(m\) the energy attenuation coefficient of air in the declared band, from the tabulated standard for atmospheric absorption at the measured temperature, humidity, and pressure. \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}}\) is continuous, non-negative, non-decreasing in \(\mathcal{F}\), zero at the datum, and uniform. It departs from the default and satisfies the binding closure, and it is rejected if the default fits at least as well (closure (iv)), as is expected in bands where air absorption is negligible. Absorption at the scatterers' surfaces is bounded below tolerance (precondition 4) and is not declared. * Drive. Default, \(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} = 0\) (§0.1 item 5). * Branch II evidence (closure (v)). * The trend of \(\langle heta angle\) and a bound on \(\int\langle heta angle\,d au\) come from the surveyed volume of the enclosure, which must stay within the rigid tolerance; for this rigid domain the evidence is that tolerance check. * \(\lim\langle\Theta_E angle > 0\) is estimated from measured dissipation (§0.1 item 7): * the supply term uses the calibrated source power and \(\mathcal{F}\) on the source surface from a set of microphones on it; * the bounding-surface term uses the normal intensity into the surfaces, measured by a second, independent set of pressure–velocity probes at declared sampling positions over them, with \(\mathcal{F}\) there from the same probes; its sampling error over a large surface is part of the declared tolerance; * the consumption term uses the tabulated \(k_{\mathrm{a}}\) at the measured air conditions with \(\mathcal{F}\) from a second, independent microphone record; * the storage term uses repeated maps of \(\mathcal{F}\).

The $O_1$ test uses an interior section, a different surface, and its own instruments.
  • The physical dissipation is the conversion of acoustic energy into heat by the bounding surfaces and the air, which is non-negative by the second law, so the comparison tests only the sign of the estimate. \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}\) is the entropy production of the declared mapping, not of that heat (§0.1 item 7).
  • Admissible domains (declared, checkable preconditions):
  • no interior source: no other sound source in or near the enclosure in the declared band, with the background energy density, measured with the test source silent before the prior steady state, below a declared fraction of the prior steady-state \(\mathcal{F}\) everywhere in \(\mathcal{M}\); and \( abla\mathcal{F} eq 0\) throughout \( ar{\mathcal{M}}\), checked against the predicted steady solution before the window and against the measured maps of \(\mathcal{F}\) in it, at the resolution of precondition 8;
  • the diffuse regime: a declared band above the frequency at which the modes of the enclosure overlap, wide enough that \(\mathcal{F}\) averages over many modes; every point of \(\mathcal{M}\) at least a declared number of mean free paths from the source, and the error of the diffusion law within about one mean free path of the bounding surfaces within the declared tolerance; a mean absorption coefficient of the bounding surfaces below a declared bound; and \(\lambda\vert abla\mathcal{F}\vert \ll \mathcal{F}\) throughout \(\mathcal{M}\);
  • a single storage class: scatterers, where present, distributed uniformly within tolerance, checked by survey in two or more subregions; and the energy stored in the linings of the bounding surfaces below the flux tolerance, by a declared bound (their thickness and porosity, and their relaxation time against the field's);
  • an absorbing, closed boundary: every part of the bounding surface absorbs, with in-situ absorption coefficients between declared positive bounds; the enclosure has no opening to another volume; and absorption by the scatterers is below a declared bound;
  • a rigid, still enclosure: volume within the rigid tolerance, bounding surfaces and scatterers fixed, the enclosure unoccupied, and nothing moving within the window;
  • still, uniform air: mean air speeds low enough that advection of acoustic energy is negligible against its diffusion (a declared bound on their ratio across \(\ell\)), no ventilation within the window, and temperature, humidity, and pressure uniform and held within tolerance, so that \(c_*\), \(D\), and \(k_{\mathrm{a}}\) are constant;
  • the source: omnidirectional within tolerance in the declared band, radiating stationary random noise at held power, with its acoustic power calibrated; absorption within the excised region and the change of energy stored in it below the flux tolerance, so that the inflow across the source surface rises to its new level without overshoot within a declared rise time, checked from the microphones on that surface;
  • the instruments: the dynamic capability of the intensity and pressure–velocity probes exceeds, by a declared margin, the field's ratio of mean-square pressure to net intensity, which is large in a diffuse field; the estimate of \(u\) from mean-square pressure (\(p^2/ ho_0c_*^2\), valid in the diffuse regime) agrees with pressure–velocity estimates at declared check points; and the random error of each map of \(\mathcal{F}\), after averaging over a declared number of repeated steps, is below a declared fraction of the predicted change of \(\mathcal{F}\) across the spacing of the microphones, not of \(\mathcal{F}\) itself: in the diffuse regime \(\mathcal{F}\) is nearly uniform (\(\lambda\vert abla\mathcal{F}\vert \ll \mathcal{F}\)), so precondition 1 and the \(O_1\) test rest on small differences between large mean-square pressures.
  • Titled phenomena outside the domain.
  • Sound sources and resonance. The source and its resonances lie in the excised region and enter through the supply data (the held power and its spectrum in the declared band). The resonance of vibrating bodies and air columns is context.
  • Direct sound, early reflections, and low-frequency modes. The direct sound, early reflections, and echoes precede the diffuse regime, and below the frequency at which they overlap the modes of an enclosure are resolved individually. Both lie outside the declared field and are context.
  • Outdoor propagation and transmission. Sound outdoors, without an enclosure, builds no stored diffuse field and is context. Sound transmitted out through the bounding surfaces leaves \(\mathcal{M}\) and is counted in their exchange.
  • Hearing and the perception of space. Hearing, and the perception of reverberance and of the size of a space, are processes of listeners outside \(\mathcal{M}\) and are context; no listener is present within windows.
  • Rhythmic entrainment. The alignment of the timing of organisms, human or other, with a periodic sound is a property of the organisms, outside \(\mathcal{M}\); it is described at cohort level and is context. Within windows the source signal is stationary noise, so no rhythm is present in the declared field. A tempo or a meter is a temporal quantity and is never mapped to \( heta\), \(\sigma\), \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}\), or any spatial operator. A claim of entrainment would be a claim of synchronization, which would belong to gauge transport (§0.1 item 10); none is made.
  • Acoustic history. Changes of the enclosure's surfaces, linings, and contents lie between windows; they enter through the declared parameters and are mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) to \(\mathcal{H}\), not identified with it.

docs.title: 2. Coordinate-by-Coordinate Mapping (\(O_0 \to O_\Omega\))
\(O_0\) — Exogenous Flux & Emergent Foliation Time
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( heta \equiv -N K \overset{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0}{=} rac{1}{2}g^{\mu u} rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} = rac{1}{\sqrt{\vert g\vert}} rac{\partial\sqrt{\vert g\vert}}{\partial au} = abla_\mu J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu \ge 0\); \(\Theta_E \equiv rac{\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}}{s_0} = - rac{ eta_{\mathrm{th}}}{s_0}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F}\); \(\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \sqrt{ heta^2 + \Theta_E^2}\), \( au_\Theta( au) \equiv \int_{ au_0}^{ au}\langle\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au'\); \( rac{dV_{\mathcal{M}}}{d au} = \int_{\mathcal{M}} heta\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx = \oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\), with \(\lim_{ au o\infty}V_{\mathcal{M}}( au) = V_\infty < \infty\) (Branch II); \( rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} \equiv J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), \(q(\mathbf{x}, au) \equiv -\ln(v_0Q(\mathbf{x}, au))\).
  • Physical Instantiation: The enclosure is rigid, so \( heta \equiv 0\), \(dV_{\mathcal{M}}/d au = 0\), and \(V_{\mathcal{M}} = V_\infty\) at every \( au\). The expansion current enters only through its vanishing divergence and boundary flux. The acoustic power entering at the source surface and leaving through the bounding surfaces is throughput and is never mapped to it, and the oscillating compressions of the air are not \( heta\) (§0.1 item 6). Openness is carried by throughput: acoustic energy spreading down its gradient gives \(\Theta_E > 0\) (by \(O_1\)), the entropy production of the declared mapping (§0.1 item 7), so \(\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} = \Theta_E\) and \( au_\Theta\) counts that production per \(s_0\), while \( au\) remains laboratory proper time. Along the throughput current \(J_E^\mu = J_W^\mu/p_0\) the record accumulates by \(\partial_ au\mathcal{H} = J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\) (§0.1 item 10). The acoustic history of the enclosure (changes of its surfaces, linings, and contents) is mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) to \(\mathcal{H}\) and is not identified with it. Within the window such changes are excluded, and they enter through \(\mathcal{H}_0\).

docs.title: \(O_1\) — Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamic Openness
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} = p_0\dot{V}_{\mathcal{M}} = p_0\oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} \equiv \int_{\mathcal{M}}(-J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F})\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} + \dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\); \( abla_\mu\mathcal{F} eq 0\); \(J_E^\mu \equiv rac{J_W^\mu}{p_0} = - rac{1}{p_0}\mathfrak{K}^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\) (Branch II, fixed); \(J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} < 0\); \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}} = - eta_{\mathrm{th}}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} > 0\).
  • Physical Instantiation: The maintained difference in acoustic energy density between the source surface and the absorbing surfaces, together with air absorption, holds the field far from equilibrium. With \(J_E^\mu = -p_0^{-1}D\,g^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\), \(J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} < 0\) holds identically wherever \( abla\mathcal{F} eq 0\) (precondition 1), so \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}} > 0\) and \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\), as identities of the declared mapping (§0.1 item 7). Acoustic energy spreads down its gradient from the source surface toward the absorbing surfaces, in the direction of \(J_E^\mu\). \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} = 0\), so \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}} = \dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\). The empirical content of \(O_1\) is the flux-prediction test (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3, §5.5 item 6). \(D\) is estimated per closure (ii) from the surveyed mean free path and the speed of sound at the measured air temperature, and \(s\) from the survey of the scatterers. The declared law must predict \(J_W^{\mathrm{meas}} = j^{\mathrm{meas}}/s\) across a declared interior section \(S\), with \(j^{\mathrm{meas}}\) the band-limited, averaged net intensity normal to \(S\) from a set of intensity probes on \(S\), and \( abla\mathcal{F}\) from the energy density measured by an array of pressure microphones on both sides of \(S\); neither uses the other or the declared \(D\) or \(k_{\mathrm{a}}\). In a diffuse field the net intensity is small against \(c_*\mathcal{F}\), which is why the probes' dynamic capability is a precondition (precondition 8). This aperture is not among the systems of the current flux-prediction test.

docs.title: \(O_2\) — Unimodular Weyl Factorization, Constraint Precision & Trajectories
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}( au, \mathbf{x}) = \Omega^2( au, \mathbf{x})\hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) with \(\det\hat{g} = 1\), \(\mathrm{Tr}(\hat{h}) = 0 \implies \det g = \Omega^{2n}\), \( rac{\partial\ln\Omega}{\partial au} = rac{1}{n} heta\); \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\); \(G_{\mu u} = \kappa_G T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}}\), \(R = \kappa_G abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha\); \( rac{2(n-1)}{n} abla^2 heta + rac{2R}{n} heta = -\kappa_G rac{\partial( abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha)}{\partial au} + 2 abla^\alpha abla^ eta\sigma_{\alpha eta} - 2\sigma^{\alpha eta}R_{\alpha eta}\); \(\left.\left( rac{dv^\mu}{d au} + \Gamma^\mu_{ ho\epsilon}v^ ho v^\epsilon + g^{\mu\lambda}\left( rac{\partial g_{\lambda u}}{\partial au} ight)v^ u - rac{1}{2}\left( rac{\partial g_{ ho\epsilon}}{\partial au}v^ ho v^\epsilon ight)v^\mu ight) ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}}\), \(f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}} = (1-u^2)\left(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} - c_*^{-2}(g_{\alpha eta}a^\alpha_{\mathrm{d}}v^ eta)v^\mu ight)\), \(u^2 = g_{\mu u}v^\mu v^ u/c_*^2 < 1\), with the default \(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} = 0\).
  • Physical Instantiation: In the rigid enclosure the unimodular Weyl split is trivial (\(\Omega \equiv 1\), \(\hat{h} \equiv 0\), \(\partial_ au\ln\Omega = 0\)). The split isolates the volume element only algebraically; \( heta\) remains coupled to \(\xi_\alpha = \hat{\Pi}_{\alpha\lambda}\eta^\lambda\) and \(\sigma_{\alpha eta}\) through the traced elliptic \( au\)-compatibility equation (r10 Decision 2), whose two sides vanish identically here (§0.1 items 2 and 4). The static pressure of the air, the oscillating acoustic pressure, and the radiation pressure of sound are not \(T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}}\). The shape of the enclosure and its scatterers enter through \(D\), the Robin exchange, and the declared geometry of \(\mathcal{M}\), not through \(g\). \(\Pi_{\mu u}\) is the Hessian of a declared precision potential and enters only the coupling sector (\(O_6\)). Eq. [3] is instantiated with the default drive and maps no tracer. Sound rays, including the paths of reflection and scattering on which the mean-free-path model is built, are null for the declared cone and are not trajectories. The movements of sources, persons, and objects are forced motions outside \(\mathcal{M}\), and none occurs within windows.

docs.title: \(O_3\) — Shear Damping & Hysteresis Consolidation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\left. rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = rac{2}{n} heta g_{\mu u} + 2\sigma_{\mu u}\); \( abla_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} \equiv \partial_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} = -\gamma_\sigma\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\) (\(\gamma_\sigma = \mathrm{const} > 0\), \(\sigma^\mu_{\;\mu} = 0\)) \(\implies \lim_{ au o\infty}\Vert\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\Vert_{C^2(\mathcal{M})} = 0\); \(\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}) \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{M})} \hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x})\), \((\hat{g}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))_{\mu u} \equiv \hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) (\(\det\hat{g}_\infty = \det\hat{g} = 1\)); \(V_{\mathrm{local}}( au) \equiv \int_{\mathcal{U}_i}\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x}, au)\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx\).
  • Physical Instantiation: In the rigid enclosure \(\sigma^\mu_{\; u} \equiv 0\), so the shear law holds trivially for any \(\gamma_\sigma > 0\), \(\hat{h} = \hat{h}_\infty = 0\), and \(\hat{g}_\infty = \hat{g} = \delta\); this aperture supports no shear-relaxation test (§0.1 item 2). The rise of the field toward its new steady state is a property of the \(O_4\) balance law and is not mapped to \(\sigma\). The decay of a reverberant field after its source stops is likewise a relaxation of \(\mathcal{F}\), not shear, and is not a Branch II window (§0.1 item 1); reverberation time is never mapped to \(\gamma_\sigma\). The vibrations of the bounding surfaces and the oscillations of the sound field are periodic and are never mapped to \(\sigma\). \(V_{\mathrm{local}}\) is the hysteresis content of a cover set.

docs.title: \(O_4\) — Free-Energy Balance, Spectral Low-Pass Gating & Boundary Stress Conservation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( rac{\partial\mathcal{F}}{\partial au} + \mathcal{F} heta = - abla_\alpha J_W^\alpha - \mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}}\), \(J_W^\alpha \equiv -\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} abla_ eta\mathcal{F}\), \(\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} = \mathfrak{K}^{ eta\alpha} \succ 0\), \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}} \ge 0\); \(\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}} \equiv \mathbf{1}_{(- abla^2 \le \Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}^2)}\); \(Q(\mathbf{x}, au) = \langle\mathbf{x}\vert ho_{\mathrm{local}}( au)\vert\mathbf{x} angle > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{var}} = rac{1}{t_0 eta_{\mathrm{th}}}D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q \parallel P) > 0\); \( abla^2\xi_ u + R_ u^{\;\alpha}\xi_\alpha = 0 \iff abla^\mu T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}} = 0\).
  • Physical Instantiation: With \( heta \equiv 0\) the balance law reads \(\partial_ au\mathcal{F} = D abla^2\mathcal{F} - k_{\mathrm{a}}\mathcal{F}\), with the held inflow at the source surface and the Robin exchange at the bounding surfaces: the diffusion equation of acoustic energy in a reverberant enclosure, normalized by its storage coefficient. Its finite relaxation time makes the field stored, not quasi-static. The air-absorption sink departs from the default and satisfies the binding closure, and it is rejected if the default fits at least as well (closure (iv)). The gate sector follows §0.1 item 8: the Neumann eigenmodes of \(- abla^2\) on the rigid domain are fixed, so the gate does not drift. They coincide in shape with the acoustic modes of a rigid-walled enclosure of the same shape, but the gate is a spatial projector on the declared state sector, not a filter in frequency, and the declared field does not resolve modes. The faster decay of fine spatial structure in the energy field is mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) to the gate without being the gate. The dependence of absorption on frequency is a property of the declared parameters across bands, not the spatial gate. The stress-conservation equivalence holds identically (§0.1 item 4).

docs.title: \(O_5\) — Riemannian Geometric Mean Gluing, Percolation & Harmonic Circulation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}^{(ij)} \equiv (g^{(i)} \# g^{(j)})_{\mu u}\); \(\mathcal{U}_{ij}\) geodesically convex for \(g^{(ij)}( au) \; orall au \ge au_0\); \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}}(\mathcal{K}) = \vert\mathcal{K}\vert/\vert\mathcal{K}_0\vert > \phi_c\); \(\Delta_{\mathrm{Hodge}}\mathbf{J}_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{harm}} = 0\); \(\partial_ au\sqrt{\vert g^{(i)}\vert} \ge 0\); \(g_{\mu u}^{(i)} \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{U}_i)} G_{\infty,\mu u}^{(i)} \succ 0\) (standing hypothesis with \(H_0 = 0\)).
  • Physical Instantiation: The cover consists of \( au\)-independent subregions of \(\mathcal{M}\): one cover set around the source surface, containing it (a concave part of \(\partial\mathcal{M}\)); one cover set around each re-entrant part of the bounding surface, containing it; and further sets that are intersections of \(\mathcal{M}\) with strictly convex bodies clear of those concave parts. Every overlap is declared clear of the concave parts and convex on the rigid metric (§0.1 item 9). Each \(g^{(i)}\) is the restriction of \(g\), so the gluing holds identically, \(\partial_ au\sqrt{\vert g^{(i)}\vert} = 0\), and \(g^{(i)} = G_\infty^{(i)}\) at every \( au\) (\(H_0 = 0\)). Every overlap is crossed by the transient, so \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}} = 1 > \phi_c\). The connectedness of the air between the scatterers is a property of the medium that enters through \(D\): a packing of scatterers that closed the paths of sound would have no continuum diffusion coefficient and would not be an admissible domain. That connectedness is mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) to the condition \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}} > \phi_c\) and is not identified with it. Whether the excised source region is a concave dent or an interior cavity, it does not raise \(b_1(\mathcal{M})\); \(b_1 > 0\) only where a fixed body joins two separate parts of the bounding surface or the enclosure has a handle, and then harmonic Neumann fields circulate around those bodies. No transport current or measured field is identified with them, and no claim is made about them; the declared current \(J_W = -D\,d\mathcal{F}\) is exact and has no harmonic component (§0.1 item 9).

docs.title: \(O_6\) — Asymmetric Phase-Lead Coupling & Trace-Free Deformation Operator
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \((J_{[i o j]})_ u = -(J_{[j o i]})_ u\); \(M^{(ij)}(\mathbf{x}) eq 0 \; orall \mathbf{x} \in ar{\mathcal{U}}_{ij}\) (hypothesis) \(\wedge \; \mathrm{Tr}\,M^{(ij)} = 0 \implies m_+ > 0 > m_-\); \( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) = k_{\mathcal{I}}\oint_{\partial\mathcal{U}_{ij}} S_{\mu u}^{(ij)}\hat{n}^\mu\hat{n}^ u\,dA > 0\) (hypothesis, \(\langle i,j angle \in \mathcal{K}\)), with this boundary flux integrable on \([ au_0, \infty)\) (Branch II).
  • Physical Instantiation: Take two adjacent cover sets that share an overlap \(\mathcal{U}_{ij}\) along a path from the source surface toward an absorbing surface. The partner fields are the rate of change of the acoustic free-energy flux in the two orientations (§0.1 item 9), so \(\eta_{[i o j]} = \partial_ au J_W\): a spatially resolved flux field, not a temporal lag between scalar signals such as the source signal and a microphone record.
  • The supply is a held inflow, so after the step the flux at the source surface does not overshoot. In a one-dimensional or radially symmetric configuration the flux would rise at every interior point, and \(\partial_ au J_W\) would point away from the source throughout the interior of \(\mathcal{M}\), vanishing only on the source surface, which every overlap stays clear of (§0.1 item 9).
  • The declared enclosure, with its excised region placed where the preconditions allow and its own shape, is in general neither, so the direction of \(\partial_ au J_W\) and any zero set are located only by the predicted solution, from the independently estimated \(D\), \(A\), and \(k_{\mathrm{a}}\) and the declared source power.
  • The declared overlap is one that the predicted zero set does not reach during the overlap's window, with the detection threshold and the travel-time margin of §0.1 item 9; on it \(\eta_{[i o j]}\) keeps one direction, which the declaration states from the predicted solution.

The odd 1-form \(J_{[i o j]} = -J_{[j o i]}\) is its image under the declared non-singular precision map, with distinct Hessians, and is non-zero there. Under the non-degeneracy hypothesis \(M^{(ij)} eq 0\), built per r7 \(O_6\) Eq. [3], \(\mathrm{Tr}\,M^{(ij)} = 0\) gives \(m_+ > 0 > m_-\), with \(m_+ eq -m_-\) in general. The eigendirections are directions of the operator \(M^{(ij)}\), not directions in which sound propagates or is reflected, and not directions of enhanced or suppressed transmission. Under the flux-positivity hypothesis the coupling transmits correlation between the subsystem marginals of the declared state sector (\( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) > 0\)). Both are standing hypotheses, not consequences of diffusion, and this aperture is not among the systems of the current coupling test. In Branch II the transient decays as the field settles, so the coupling flux is integrable on \([ au_0, \infty)\). With \(\sigma \equiv 0\) the overlaps keep their declared convex shape, and the r10 §5.12 constraint has no counterpart here.

docs.title: \(O_7\) — Principal-Bundle Gauge Coherence, Impedance Decay & Hysteresis Alignment
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(D_\mu = \partial_\mu - i g_{\mathrm{YM}}\,\mathrm{ad}_{A_\mu}\); \(\Vert\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu\Vert_{C^1(\mathcal{M})} o 0 \implies [F_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{YM}}, \hat{\chi}] o 0\); \(\chi_E \equiv 1 + rac{n\,\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\sigma^ u_{\;\mu}}{ heta^2 + \langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}}^2} o 1\), \(\hat{\chi} \equiv \chi_E\hat{u}\) (Branch II); \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\hat{ ho}_g( au) \parallel \hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}( au)) o 0\).
  • Physical Instantiation: The gauge sector is the trivial declaration of §0.1 item 10, so \([F_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{YM}}, \hat{\chi}] = 0\) identically. With \(\sigma \equiv 0\), \(\chi_E \equiv 1\) and \(\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu \equiv 0\) at every \( au\), and \(\chi\) is undefined (\( heta = 0\)). \(\hat{ ho}_g = rac{1}{n}\delta^\mu_ u\) at every \( au\), and alignment with \(\hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}\) holds where the Hessian of the declared convex record becomes isotropic, an asymptotic condition stated and not tested. The \(O_7\) Eq. [3] identities hold with divergence-free \(J_{\mathrm{geom}}\) and \(u_{\mathrm{exp}}\), bounded \(J_E\), and \(\hat{h} \equiv \hat{h}_\infty\). The phase relations of sound waves (their interference), which the band- and time-averaged field does not carry, and the alignment of the timing of organisms with a periodic sound, are not mapped to the gauge connection; they are context, and no coherence, synchronization, or entrainment claim is made.

docs.title: \(O_\Omega\) — Topological Asymptote, Branch II: Bounded Non-Equilibrium Steady State
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: Branch II (\(H_0 = 0\)): \( heta \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{C^2(\mathcal{M})} 0\) with \(\int_{ au_0}^{\infty}\langle heta angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au < \infty\) and \(\langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}} o \Theta_\infty > 0\); \(\sigma^\mu_{\; u} o 0\); \(\partial_ au g_{\mu u} o 0\); \(V_{\mathcal{M}} o V_\infty\) and \(\mathcal{I}( au) o s_0V_\infty\); \(\left.\hat{\mathbb{L}}_{\mathrm{stat}}(\mathbf{x})\Psi[g_{\mu u}, \mathcal{H}] ight\vert_{\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{sol}}[g]} = (J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q) rac{\delta\Psi}{\delta\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x})} \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{} 0 \iff J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0 \iff rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} o 0\) (with \(\vert\delta\Psi/\delta\mathcal{H}\vert\) bounded and bounded away from \(0\) uniformly as \( au o \infty\)).
  • Physical Instantiation: Under a held source power the enclosure approaches a steady diffuse field that carries a steady flux of acoustic energy from the source surface, partly absorbed by the air and partly by the bounding surfaces: a bounded non-equilibrium steady state. \( heta \equiv 0\), \(V_{\mathcal{M}} = V_\infty\), \(\langle\Theta_E angle o \Theta_\infty > 0\) while the source sounds, \(\sigma \equiv 0\), and \(\partial_ au g \equiv 0\). The transient coupling decays, so \(\mathcal{I} o s_0V_\infty\). The generator condition requires \(J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0\), an asymptotic hypothesis on the declared state sector that no finite window tests. The state is neither static equilibrium, which would be silence (a uniform zero field with no flux), nor a periodic return: rhythmic and modulated signals are excluded from windows, and successive steps of source power form a sequence of windows. The limit belongs to the declared idealization of held power in a still, unoccupied enclosure under held air conditions; the physical field leaves it as those conditions drift, which bounds the usable window.
  • Within windows the supported tests (aperture_generation_guidance.md §5.5) are the non-degeneracy check (4), the signs of \(\Theta_E\), \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}\), and \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}}\) (5), the flux prediction (6), and the Branch II evidence (7).
  • Tests (1)–(3) hold trivially in the rigid enclosure.
  • No current test exercises this aperture.

docs.title: Aperture 5.2: Poetic Prosody & Psycholinguistic Condensation (\(\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{poetic}}\); provisionally homological)
1. Epistemological & Linguistic Scope
docs.text:
Aperture 5.2 maps how verse organizes sound and meaning: the production of speech, in which air driven from the lungs is set into vibration at the larynx and shaped by the vocal tract; prosody, the patterning of stress, duration, pitch, and phrasing; the metrical structure of verse, which regularizes that patterning; and the comprehension of language, including condensation, the packing of much meaning into few words in figurative and compressed expression. Lexicon is strictly restricted to phonetics and speech science, prosody and metrics, poetics, and psycholinguistics.

Status (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3; provisionally homological). This aperture declares no empirical domain and makes no empirical claim in this epoch (§0.1 item 12). The airflow of speech is inertial: through the glottis and the vocal tract it is governed by the momentum of the air (jet formation, flow separation, turbulence), not by a conductance acting on a stored quantity, and the sound it generates is a propagating wave. Neither is a stored field relaxing by diffusion, which aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3 item 3 requires. Prosody, meter, and meaning are, besides, properties of languages, texts, and their users, not fields on one declared domain. Each coordinate is therefore mapped as a conceptual correspondence, mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) and never a reductive identity. Speakers, readers, and listeners are described at cohort level; practices of speaking or reading verse are context and are not mapped.

docs.title: 2. Coordinate-by-Coordinate Mapping (\(O_0 \to O_\Omega\))
\(O_0\) — Exogenous Flux & Emergent Foliation Time
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( heta \equiv -N K \overset{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0}{=} rac{1}{2}g^{\mu u} rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} = rac{1}{\sqrt{\vert g\vert}} rac{\partial\sqrt{\vert g\vert}}{\partial au} = abla_\mu J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu \ge 0\); \(\Theta_E \equiv rac{\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}}{s_0} = - rac{ eta_{\mathrm{th}}}{s_0}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F}\); \(\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \sqrt{ heta^2 + \Theta_E^2}\), \( au_\Theta( au) \equiv \int_{ au_0}^{ au}\langle\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au'\); \( rac{dV_{\mathcal{M}}}{d au} = \int_{\mathcal{M}} heta\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx = \oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\), with \(\lim_{ au o\infty}V_{\mathcal{M}}( au) = V_\infty < \infty\) (Branch II); \( rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} \equiv J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), \(q(\mathbf{x}, au) \equiv -\ln(v_0Q(\mathbf{x}, au))\).
  • Homological Mapping: Speech is sustained by a supply: the respiratory muscles maintain the pressure that drives air through the larynx, and metabolism maintains the muscles that shape the tract. That sustained throughput corresponds to the throughput rate \(\Theta_E\) of a Branch II state, in which openness is carried by throughput and not by expansion (\( heta o 0\)); the vocal tract is bounded, and the cyclic changes of volume of the respiratory system are not \( heta\). The conventions a language community holds (its stock of words, idioms, figures, and metrical patterns) grow with use, and they change most where usage meets the unexpected, as when a new figure is coined and taken up. That growth corresponds to the record law \(\partial_ au\mathcal{H} = J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\) along the throughput, as a correspondence between a community's accumulated conventions and the record \(\mathcal{H}\), not an identity.

docs.title: \(O_1\) — Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamic Openness
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} = p_0\dot{V}_{\mathcal{M}} = p_0\oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} \equiv \int_{\mathcal{M}}(-J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F})\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} + \dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\); \( abla_\mu\mathcal{F} eq 0\); \(J_E^\mu \equiv rac{J_W^\mu}{p_0} = - rac{1}{p_0}\mathfrak{K}^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\) (Branch II, fixed); \(J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} < 0\); \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}} = - eta_{\mathrm{th}}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} > 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: The aerodynamic power of speech is mostly dissipated: only a small fraction of the power delivered by the airflow leaves the mouth as sound, and the rest is lost to viscous and turbulent dissipation in the larynx and the vocal tract. That loss corresponds to the dissipative power \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\) and to positive entropy production. The pressure drop from the lungs to the lips is a difference of energy density and corresponds to the gradient of \(\mathcal{F}\); the flow it drives, however, is set by the inertia of the air, through a Bernoulli relation between pressure drop and velocity, and not by a conductance, which is one reason no transport tensor is declared. No flux prediction is made.

docs.title: \(O_2\) — Unimodular Weyl Factorization, Constraint Precision & Trajectories
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}( au, \mathbf{x}) = \Omega^2( au, \mathbf{x})\hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) with \(\det\hat{g} = 1\), \(\mathrm{Tr}(\hat{h}) = 0 \implies \det g = \Omega^{2n}\), \( rac{\partial\ln\Omega}{\partial au} = rac{1}{n} heta\); \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\); \(G_{\mu u} = \kappa_G T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}}\), \(R = \kappa_G abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha\); \( rac{2(n-1)}{n} abla^2 heta + rac{2R}{n} heta = -\kappa_G rac{\partial( abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha)}{\partial au} + 2 abla^\alpha abla^ eta\sigma_{\alpha eta} - 2\sigma^{\alpha eta}R_{\alpha eta}\); \(\left.\left( rac{dv^\mu}{d au} + \Gamma^\mu_{ ho\epsilon}v^ ho v^\epsilon + g^{\mu\lambda}\left( rac{\partial g_{\lambda u}}{\partial au} ight)v^ u - rac{1}{2}\left( rac{\partial g_{ ho\epsilon}}{\partial au}v^ ho v^\epsilon ight)v^\mu ight) ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}}\), \(f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}} = (1-u^2)\left(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} - c_*^{-2}(g_{\alpha eta}a^\alpha_{\mathrm{d}}v^ eta)v^\mu ight)\), \(u^2 = g_{\mu u}v^\mu v^ u/c_*^2 < 1\), with the default \(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} = 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: A vocal tract has an overall size and a shape, the distribution of cross-sectional area along it, which sets vowel quality; listeners identify the same vowel produced by tracts of different sizes. That separation of scale from shape corresponds to the Weyl split of the volume factor \(\Omega\) from the unimodular shape \(\hat{h}\), and, as in every aperture, the traced elliptic \( au\)-compatibility equation keeps the two coupled (r10 Decision 2), as the size of a tract constrains the shapes it can reach. In task-dynamic models of speech production, each articulatory gesture moves toward a target with a declared stiffness, high for the constrictions of consonants and lower for vowels; the stiffness of a gesture's target corresponds to the precision Hessian \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\), as a correspondence between roles, not between quantities. The movement of the articulators toward their targets corresponds to the trajectory equation with a declared drive: a forced, goal-directed motion, which r7 admits only through a declared drive under the binding closure. No drive is declared and no trajectory is mapped.

docs.title: \(O_3\) — Shear Damping & Hysteresis Consolidation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\left. rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = rac{2}{n} heta g_{\mu u} + 2\sigma_{\mu u}\); \( abla_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} \equiv \partial_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} = -\gamma_\sigma\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\) (\(\gamma_\sigma = \mathrm{const} > 0\), \(\sigma^\mu_{\;\mu} = 0\)) \(\implies \lim_{ au o\infty}\Vert\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\Vert_{C^2(\mathcal{M})} = 0\); \(\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}) \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{M})} \hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x})\), \((\hat{g}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))_{\mu u} \equiv \hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) (\(\det\hat{g}_\infty = \det\hat{g} = 1\)); \(V_{\mathrm{local}}( au) \equiv \int_{\mathcal{U}_i}\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x}, au)\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx\).
  • Homological Mapping: After a reader or listener has processed a sentence of a given structure, the same structure is used again with raised probability (structural priming); the raised probability declines as further material intervenes, while repeated exposure leaves a lasting change in the probabilities a speaker uses, a form of implicit learning. The pairing of a decaying transient with a retained change corresponds to the decay of shear at a constant rate as \(\hat{h}\) settles to \(\hat{h}_\infty\) while \(V_{\mathrm{local}}\) holds the consolidated content. The correspondence concerns that pairing. The decline of priming is not known to follow a single exponential, and no rate of a linguistic process is mapped to \(\gamma_\sigma\).

docs.title: \(O_4\) — Free-Energy Balance, Spectral Low-Pass Gating & Boundary Stress Conservation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( rac{\partial\mathcal{F}}{\partial au} + \mathcal{F} heta = - abla_\alpha J_W^\alpha - \mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}}\), \(J_W^\alpha \equiv -\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} abla_ eta\mathcal{F}\), \(\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} = \mathfrak{K}^{ eta\alpha} \succ 0\), \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}} \ge 0\); \(\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}} \equiv \mathbf{1}_{(- abla^2 \le \Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}^2)}\); \(Q(\mathbf{x}, au) = \langle\mathbf{x}\vert ho_{\mathrm{local}}( au)\vert\mathbf{x} angle > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{var}} = rac{1}{t_0 eta_{\mathrm{th}}}D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q \parallel P) > 0\); \( abla^2\xi_ u + R_ u^{\;\alpha}\xi_\alpha = 0 \iff abla^\mu T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}} = 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: In psycholinguistics, the surprisal of a word, the negative logarithm of its probability given its context, predicts the effort of processing it. That measure corresponds to the surprisal \(q = -\ln(v_0Q)\) of r7, with the distribution over continuations that a reader builds corresponding to the gated density \(Q\), and the divergence \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q \parallel P)\) from a reference distribution to the cost \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{var}}\) of holding an interpretation apart from what was expected. Condensation keeps the coarse structure of what is expressed and leaves fine detail implicit; that corresponds to the gate \(\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}}\), which keeps low spatial modes and removes fine structure. The gate is a spatial projector onto Neumann eigenmodes, and the correspondence is between the roles of keeping coarse and removing fine structure; it corresponds neither to the frequency content of speech nor to the temporal regularity of meter. The balance law corresponds to the replenishment of the pressure below the larynx by the respiratory muscles against its loss through the glottis, as a correspondence only, since that pressure is not a diffusing stored field. The stress-conservation equivalence \( abla^2\xi_ u + R_ u^{\;\alpha}\xi_\alpha = 0 \iff abla^\mu T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}} = 0\) has no counterpart here.

docs.title: \(O_5\) — Riemannian Geometric Mean Gluing, Percolation & Harmonic Circulation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}^{(ij)} \equiv (g^{(i)} \# g^{(j)})_{\mu u}\); \(\mathcal{U}_{ij}\) geodesically convex for \(g^{(ij)}( au) \; orall au \ge au_0\); \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}}(\mathcal{K}) = \vert\mathcal{K}\vert/\vert\mathcal{K}_0\vert > \phi_c\); \(\Delta_{\mathrm{Hodge}}\mathbf{J}_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{harm}} = 0\); \(\partial_ au\sqrt{\vert g^{(i)}\vert} \ge 0\); \(g_{\mu u}^{(i)} \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{U}_i)} G_{\infty,\mu u}^{(i)} \succ 0\) (standing hypothesis with \(H_0 = 0\)).
  • Homological Mapping: Verse lines are units of their own, and a phrase that runs on across a line break (enjambment) joins two lines while each keeps its metrical shape. That joining corresponds to the gluing of local metrics over an overlap by the geometric mean, \(g^{(ij)} = g^{(i)} \# g^{(j)}\), which keeps each cover set's metric. A text becomes a connected whole once enough links between its parts (repetitions, rhymes, recurring images) are present, which corresponds to the percolation condition \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}}(\mathcal{K}) > \phi_c\). A text that returns to an earlier point, as a refrain does, corresponds to a non-trivial cycle and to harmonic circulation around it, as a correspondence between a sequence's returns and a manifold's topology, not an identity.

docs.title: \(O_6\) — Asymmetric Phase-Lead Coupling & Trace-Free Deformation Operator
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \((J_{[i o j]})_ u = -(J_{[j o i]})_ u\); \(M^{(ij)}(\mathbf{x}) eq 0 \; orall \mathbf{x} \in ar{\mathcal{U}}_{ij}\) (hypothesis) \(\wedge \; \mathrm{Tr}\,M^{(ij)} = 0 \implies m_+ > 0 > m_-\); \( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) = k_{\mathcal{I}}\oint_{\partial\mathcal{U}_{ij}} S_{\mu u}^{(ij)}\hat{n}^\mu\hat{n}^ u\,dA > 0\) (hypothesis, \(\langle i,j angle \in \mathcal{K}\)), with this boundary flux integrable on \([ au_0, \infty)\) (Branch II).
  • Homological Mapping: The dependency between two constituents of a sentence is directed: one governs the other, and read the other way the relation reverses. That direction corresponds to the odd phase-lead 1-form \(J_{[i o j]} = -J_{[j o i]}\). Word order is temporal, not a spatial 1-form, and the correspondence implies no estimator. In stress, prominence and reduction are paired: a stressed syllable is lengthened and given full quality while its unstressed neighbours are shortened and reduced, by amounts that need not match. That pairing corresponds to the opposite-signed extreme eigenvalues \(m_+ > 0 > m_-\) of the trace-free operator \(M^{(ij)}\) under the non-degeneracy hypothesis, with \(m_+ eq -m_-\) in general. The growth of the information that two paired lines share as the second unfolds, as when a rhyme is completed, corresponds to the flux-positivity hypothesis \( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) > 0\). Both remain standing hypotheses of r7, and in the Branch II form the coupling must be transient (integrable), so the correspondence is with pairings that are completed, not with sustained coupling.

docs.title: \(O_7\) — Principal-Bundle Gauge Coherence, Impedance Decay & Hysteresis Alignment
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(D_\mu = \partial_\mu - i g_{\mathrm{YM}}\,\mathrm{ad}_{A_\mu}\); \(\Vert\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu\Vert_{C^1(\mathcal{M})} o 0 \implies [F_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{YM}}, \hat{\chi}] o 0\); \(\chi_E \equiv 1 + rac{n\,\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\sigma^ u_{\;\mu}}{ heta^2 + \langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}}^2} o 1\), \(\hat{\chi} \equiv \chi_E\hat{u}\) (Branch II); \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\hat{ ho}_g( au) \parallel \hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}( au)) o 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: Each line of metrical verse is read against the same template, which is carried from line to line, and mismatches between a line's natural stresses and the template are accommodated as reading proceeds. Carrying a frame of reference from place to place corresponds to gauge transport, and the reduction of mismatches to the decay of the covariant derivative \(\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu\); the correspondence concerns the transport of a frame, never the anisotropy index \(\chi_E\), which concerns the shape of deformation only. The alignment \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\hat{ ho}_g \parallel \hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}) o 0\) corresponds to the convergence of current usage with accumulated convention, as a coined figure becomes conventional.

docs.title: \(O_\Omega\) — Topological Asymptote, Branch II: Bounded Non-Equilibrium Steady State
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: Branch II (\(H_0 = 0\)): \( heta \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{C^2(\mathcal{M})} 0\) with \(\int_{ au_0}^{\infty}\langle heta angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au < \infty\) and \(\langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}} o \Theta_\infty > 0\); \(\sigma^\mu_{\; u} o 0\); \(\partial_ au g_{\mu u} o 0\); \(V_{\mathcal{M}} o V_\infty\) and \(\mathcal{I}( au) o s_0V_\infty\); \(\left.\hat{\mathbb{L}}_{\mathrm{stat}}(\mathbf{x})\Psi[g_{\mu u}, \mathcal{H}] ight\vert_{\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{sol}}[g]} = (J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q) rac{\delta\Psi}{\delta\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x})} \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{} 0 \iff J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0 \iff rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} o 0\) (with \(\vert\delta\Psi/\delta\mathcal{H}\vert\) bounded and bounded away from \(0\) uniformly as \( au o \infty\)).
  • Homological Mapping: A language community sustains its prosodic and poetic conventions through continuous use: never static equilibrium, which for a language would be the end of its use, and never a strict periodic return, although forms recur. That sustained state corresponds to the Branch II limit: bounded extent, sustained throughput (\(\langle\Theta_E angle o \Theta_\infty > 0\)), decaying shear and coupling transients, and a record whose growth stops when usage no longer meets surprise (\(J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0\)). The correspondence makes no claim about any language, text, or reader, and no test exercises this aperture in this epoch.

docs.title: Aperture 5.3: Spatial Choreography & Relational Kinesiology (\(\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{choreographic}}\); provisionally homological)
1. Epistemological & Kinesiological Scope
docs.text:
Aperture 5.3 maps how persons move in space and in relation to one another: the collective motion of groups and crowds, from the spacing that individuals keep to the flows and lanes that form among them; the coordination of movement between persons in joint action (relational kinesiology); and choreographic composition, the arrangement of moving persons in space, treated through its general principles (the distribution of movers over a space, their spacing, direction, and density). Lexicon is strictly restricted to pedestrian and crowd dynamics, collective-motion theory, movement science, and the theory of choreographic composition.

Status (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3; provisionally homological). This aperture declares no empirical domain and makes no empirical claim in this epoch (§0.1 item 12). Persons move by self-propulsion toward goals, so the density of a moving group is carried by velocities that the movers choose (advection), not spread down its own gradient by a conductance; r7's balance law has no advective term, and a regime dominated by random dispersal, in which it would hold, is the exception rather than the phenomenon. Coordination and composition are, besides, properties of persons and groups, not fields on one declared domain. Each coordinate is therefore mapped as a conceptual correspondence, mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) and never a reductive identity. Groups are described at population level; practices of movement and works of choreography are context and are not mapped.

docs.title: 2. Coordinate-by-Coordinate Mapping (\(O_0 \to O_\Omega\))
\(O_0\) — Exogenous Flux & Emergent Foliation Time
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( heta \equiv -N K \overset{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0}{=} rac{1}{2}g^{\mu u} rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} = rac{1}{\sqrt{\vert g\vert}} rac{\partial\sqrt{\vert g\vert}}{\partial au} = abla_\mu J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu \ge 0\); \(\Theta_E \equiv rac{\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}}{s_0} = - rac{ eta_{\mathrm{th}}}{s_0}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F}\); \(\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \sqrt{ heta^2 + \Theta_E^2}\), \( au_\Theta( au) \equiv \int_{ au_0}^{ au}\langle\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au'\); \( rac{dV_{\mathcal{M}}}{d au} = \int_{\mathcal{M}} heta\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx = \oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\), with \(\lim_{ au o\infty}V_{\mathcal{M}}( au) = V_\infty < \infty\) (Branch II); \( rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} \equiv J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), \(q(\mathbf{x}, au) \equiv -\ln(v_0Q(\mathbf{x}, au))\).
  • Homological Mapping: A moving group is sustained by metabolic throughput: each mover converts chemical energy into motion and heat, continuously. That throughput corresponds to the throughput rate \(\Theta_E\) of a Branch II state, in which openness is carried by throughput and not by expansion (\( heta o 0\)): a group moves within a bounded space, and its spreading and gathering are not \( heta\). Populations develop conventions for moving among others, such as a preferred side for passing, which persist and change where movement meets the unexpected. That accumulation corresponds to the record law \(\partial_ au\mathcal{H} = J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), as a correspondence between a population's conventions of movement and the record \(\mathcal{H}\), not an identity.

docs.title: \(O_1\) — Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamic Openness
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} = p_0\dot{V}_{\mathcal{M}} = p_0\oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} \equiv \int_{\mathcal{M}}(-J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F})\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} + \dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\); \( abla_\mu\mathcal{F} eq 0\); \(J_E^\mu \equiv rac{J_W^\mu}{p_0} = - rac{1}{p_0}\mathfrak{K}^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\) (Branch II, fixed); \(J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} < 0\); \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}} = - eta_{\mathrm{th}}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} > 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: Movement dissipates: the work of the muscles ends as heat, so a moving group corresponds to the dissipative power \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\) and to positive entropy production. The density of persons is not an energy density, and no gradient of it drives a flux of the form \(J_E^\mu = -p_0^{-1}\mathfrak{K}^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\); this is one reason no free energy is declared. No flux prediction is made.

docs.title: \(O_2\) — Unimodular Weyl Factorization, Constraint Precision & Trajectories
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}( au, \mathbf{x}) = \Omega^2( au, \mathbf{x})\hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) with \(\det\hat{g} = 1\), \(\mathrm{Tr}(\hat{h}) = 0 \implies \det g = \Omega^{2n}\), \( rac{\partial\ln\Omega}{\partial au} = rac{1}{n} heta\); \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\); \(G_{\mu u} = \kappa_G T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}}\), \(R = \kappa_G abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha\); \( rac{2(n-1)}{n} abla^2 heta + rac{2R}{n} heta = -\kappa_G rac{\partial( abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha)}{\partial au} + 2 abla^\alpha abla^ eta\sigma_{\alpha eta} - 2\sigma^{\alpha eta}R_{\alpha eta}\); \(\left.\left( rac{dv^\mu}{d au} + \Gamma^\mu_{ ho\epsilon}v^ ho v^\epsilon + g^{\mu\lambda}\left( rac{\partial g_{\lambda u}}{\partial au} ight)v^ u - rac{1}{2}\left( rac{\partial g_{ ho\epsilon}}{\partial au}v^ ho v^\epsilon ight)v^\mu ight) ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}}\), \(f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}} = (1-u^2)\left(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} - c_*^{-2}(g_{\alpha eta}a^\alpha_{\mathrm{d}}v^ eta)v^\mu ight)\), \(u^2 = g_{\mu u}v^\mu v^ u/c_*^2 < 1\), with the default \(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} = 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: A group occupies an overall extent and has a shape, compact or elongated, dense in some parts and sparse in others. That separation corresponds to the Weyl split of the volume factor \(\Omega\) from the unimodular shape \(\hat{h}\), and the traced elliptic \( au\)-compatibility equation keeps the two coupled (r10 Decision 2), as a group that spreads within the limits of a space also changes shape. In models of pedestrian motion each person accelerates toward a desired velocity and away from others at short range; that law corresponds to the trajectory equation with a declared drive, a forced, goal-directed motion, which r7 admits only through a declared drive under the binding closure. The stiffness with which movers keep their distance at short range corresponds to the precision Hessian \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\), as a correspondence between roles. No drive is declared and no trajectory is mapped.

docs.title: \(O_3\) — Shear Damping & Hysteresis Consolidation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\left. rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = rac{2}{n} heta g_{\mu u} + 2\sigma_{\mu u}\); \( abla_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} \equiv \partial_ au\sigma^\mu_{\; u} = -\gamma_\sigma\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\) (\(\gamma_\sigma = \mathrm{const} > 0\), \(\sigma^\mu_{\;\mu} = 0\)) \(\implies \lim_{ au o\infty}\Vert\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\Vert_{C^2(\mathcal{M})} = 0\); \(\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}) \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{M})} \hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x})\), \((\hat{g}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))_{\mu u} \equiv \hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}_\infty(\mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) (\(\det\hat{g}_\infty = \det\hat{g} = 1\)); \(V_{\mathrm{local}}( au) \equiv \int_{\mathcal{U}_i}\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x}, au)\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx\).
  • Homological Mapping: When neighbouring movers slide past one another, the configuration of a group is sheared; as relative motion dies down, the shear decays, while the spacing the group has adopted persists. That pairing corresponds to the decay of \(\sigma\) at a constant rate as \(\hat{h}\) settles to \(\hat{h}_\infty\), with \(V_{\mathrm{local}}\) holding the consolidated content. Relative motion in groups often relaxes with oscillation or in stop-and-go waves, which the mixed-form shear law excludes, and no rate of a group's motion is mapped to \(\gamma_\sigma\).

docs.title: \(O_4\) — Free-Energy Balance, Spectral Low-Pass Gating & Boundary Stress Conservation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( rac{\partial\mathcal{F}}{\partial au} + \mathcal{F} heta = - abla_\alpha J_W^\alpha - \mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}}\), \(J_W^\alpha \equiv -\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} abla_ eta\mathcal{F}\), \(\mathfrak{K}^{\alpha eta} = \mathfrak{K}^{ eta\alpha} \succ 0\), \(\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{F}} \ge 0\); \(\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}} \equiv \mathbf{1}_{(- abla^2 \le \Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}^2)}\); \(Q(\mathbf{x}, au) = \langle\mathbf{x}\vert ho_{\mathrm{local}}( au)\vert\mathbf{x} angle > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{var}} = rac{1}{t_0 eta_{\mathrm{th}}}D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q \parallel P) > 0\); \( abla^2\xi_ u + R_ u^{\;\alpha}\xi_\alpha = 0 \iff abla^\mu T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}} = 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: Continuum descriptions of crowds use a density of persons averaged over areas larger than one person, which keeps the large-scale distribution of a group and removes the detail of individual positions. That coarse-graining corresponds to the gate \(\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{\Lambda_{\mathrm{gate}}}\), which keeps low spatial modes, and the coarse-grained density to the gated density \(Q\). A composition, an intended distribution of movers over a space, corresponds to a reference \(P\), and the effort of keeping a group's actual distribution near it against dispersal to the cost \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{var}} = rac{1}{t_0 eta_{\mathrm{th}}}D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q \parallel P)\). The conservation of persons, with persons crossing the boundary of a space, corresponds to the balance law only in its bookkeeping: it is a continuity equation with advection, which is why this aperture is homological. The stress-conservation equivalence has no counterpart here.

docs.title: \(O_5\) — Riemannian Geometric Mean Gluing, Percolation & Harmonic Circulation
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}^{(ij)} \equiv (g^{(i)} \# g^{(j)})_{\mu u}\); \(\mathcal{U}_{ij}\) geodesically convex for \(g^{(ij)}( au) \; orall au \ge au_0\); \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}}(\mathcal{K}) = \vert\mathcal{K}\vert/\vert\mathcal{K}_0\vert > \phi_c\); \(\Delta_{\mathrm{Hodge}}\mathbf{J}_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{harm}} = 0\); \(\partial_ au\sqrt{\vert g^{(i)}\vert} \ge 0\); \(g_{\mu u}^{(i)} \xrightarrow{C^2(\mathcal{U}_i)} G_{\infty,\mu u}^{(i)} \succ 0\) (standing hypothesis with \(H_0 = 0\)).
  • Homological Mapping: Two groups that move in neighbouring regions and share a region in which they intermix, each keeping its own spacing, correspond to two cover sets glued over an overlap by the geometric mean, \(g^{(ij)} = g^{(i)} \# g^{(j)}\), which keeps each set's metric. A group becomes a connected body, in which every mover is linked to every other through a chain of neighbours within interaction range, once its density exceeds a threshold; that transition corresponds to the percolation condition \(\phi_{\mathrm{perc}}(\mathcal{K}) > \phi_c\). No pattern of movement is mapped to harmonic circulation: harmonic fields belong to the topology of a domain, and this aperture declares none.

docs.title: \(O_6\) — Asymmetric Phase-Lead Coupling & Trace-Free Deformation Operator
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \((J_{[i o j]})_ u = -(J_{[j o i]})_ u\); \(M^{(ij)}(\mathbf{x}) eq 0 \; orall \mathbf{x} \in ar{\mathcal{U}}_{ij}\) (hypothesis) \(\wedge \; \mathrm{Tr}\,M^{(ij)} = 0 \implies m_+ > 0 > m_-\); \( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) = k_{\mathcal{I}}\oint_{\partial\mathcal{U}_{ij}} S_{\mu u}^{(ij)}\hat{n}^\mu\hat{n}^ u\,dA > 0\) (hypothesis, \(\langle i,j angle \in \mathcal{K}\)), with this boundary flux integrable on \([ au_0, \infty)\) (Branch II).
  • Homological Mapping: When two persons coordinate their movements, one person's movement usually anticipates the other's more than the reverse, and read the other way the relation reverses. That direction corresponds to the odd phase-lead 1-form \(J_{[i o j]} = -J_{[j o i]}\). Lead–lag statistics between movement records are temporal, not spatial 1-form fields, and the correspondence implies no estimator. Models of collective motion pair attraction toward others at a distance with repulsion at short range, opposite in sign and unequal in strength; that pairing corresponds to the opposite-signed extreme eigenvalues \(m_+ > 0 > m_-\) of the trace-free operator \(M^{(ij)}\) under the non-degeneracy hypothesis, with \(m_+ eq -m_-\) in general. The growth of the information that each person's movement carries about the other's during a coordinated episode corresponds to the flux-positivity hypothesis \( rac{d}{d au}\mathcal{I}(Q_i; Q_j) > 0\). Both remain standing hypotheses of r7, and in the Branch II form the coupling must be transient (integrable), so the correspondence is with episodes of coordination that resolve, not with sustained coupling.

docs.title: \(O_7\) — Principal-Bundle Gauge Coherence, Impedance Decay & Hysteresis Alignment
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(D_\mu = \partial_\mu - i g_{\mathrm{YM}}\,\mathrm{ad}_{A_\mu}\); \(\Vert\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu\Vert_{C^1(\mathcal{M})} o 0 \implies [F_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{YM}}, \hat{\chi}] o 0\); \(\chi_E \equiv 1 + rac{n\,\sigma^\mu_{\; u}\sigma^ u_{\;\mu}}{ heta^2 + \langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}}^2} o 1\), \(\hat{\chi} \equiv \chi_E\hat{u}\) (Branch II); \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\hat{ ho}_g( au) \parallel \hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}( au)) o 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: In models of collective motion, each mover turns toward the average heading of its neighbours, so that a direction is carried from mover to mover across a group and mismatches of heading decay. That transport of a local direction corresponds to gauge transport, and the decay of mismatches to the decay of the covariant derivative \(\hat{\mathcal{E}}_\mu\); it never corresponds to the anisotropy index \(\chi_E\), which concerns the shape of deformation only. The alignment \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\hat{ ho}_g \parallel \hat{ ho}_{\mathcal{H}}) o 0\) corresponds to the convergence of a group's current movement with its accumulated conventions.

docs.text:
• Spine Equations: Branch II (\(H_0 = 0\)): \( heta \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{C^2(\mathcal{M})} 0\) with \(\int_{ au_0}^{\infty}\langle heta angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au < \infty\) and \(\langle\Theta_E angle_{\mathcal{M}} o \Theta_\infty > 0\); \(\sigma^\mu_{\; u} o 0\); \(\partial_ au g_{\mu u} o 0\); \(V_{\mathcal{M}} o V_\infty\) and \(\mathcal{I}( au) o s_0V_\infty\); \(\left.\hat{\mathbb{L}}_{\mathrm{stat}}(\mathbf{x})\Psi[g_{\mu u}, \mathcal{H}] ight\vert_{\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{sol}}[g]} = (J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q) rac{\delta\Psi}{\delta\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x})} \xrightarrow[ au o\infty]{} 0 \iff J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0 \iff rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} o 0\) (with \(\vert\delta\Psi/\delta\mathcal{H}\vert\) bounded and bounded away from \(0\) uniformly as \( au o \infty\)).
  • Homological Mapping: A population that moves through a space under a steady demand reaches a sustained, bounded pattern of flow: never stillness, which would be static equilibrium, and never a strict periodic return, although patterns of use recur. That state corresponds to the Branch II limit: bounded extent, sustained throughput (\(\langle\Theta_E angle o \Theta_\infty > 0\)), decaying shear and coupling transients, and a record whose growth stops when movement no longer meets surprise (\(J_E^\lambda abla_\lambda q o 0\)). The correspondence makes no claim about any group, space, or composition, and no test exercises this aperture in this epoch.

docs.title: Aperture 5.4: Inter-Subjective & Cross-Substrate Symbiosis (\(\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{symbiotic}}\); provisionally homological)
1. Epistemological & Systems Scope
docs.text:
Aperture 5.4 maps how heterogeneous agents, biological and artificial, form associations in which each keeps its own organization while they depend on one another: biological symbiosis, in which organisms of different kinds exchange resources across shared interfaces; communication between persons and the building of common ground; and the coupling of artificial agents with one another and with persons in multi-agent systems. Lexicon is strictly restricted to multi-agent systems theory, information theory, social cognition, and symbiosis biology.

Status (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3; provisionally homological). This aperture declares no empirical domain and makes no empirical claim in this epoch (§0.1 item 12). The media through which agents exchange signals carry them quasi-statically or as waves: a potential conducted through a medium follows its sources without a storage term, and a propagating signal is not a stored field relaxing by diffusion, so r7's balance law cannot represent either literally (aperture_generation_guidance.md §2.3 item 3). The exchanges themselves are discrete messages and transfers between agents, not fields on one declared domain. Each coordinate is therefore mapped as a conceptual correspondence, mapped via Spine \(\mathcal{T}\) and never a reductive identity. Agents are described at the level of populations and classes of systems. The internal representations of language models, which Level 2 of the validation protocol concerns, are not mapped here (empirical_validation_protocol.md §3.2).

docs.title: 2. Coordinate-by-Coordinate Mapping (\(O_0 \to O_\Omega\))
\(O_0\) — Exogenous Flux & Emergent Foliation Time
docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \( heta \equiv -N K \overset{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0}{=} rac{1}{2}g^{\mu u} rac{\partial g_{\mu u}}{\partial au} = rac{1}{\sqrt{\vert g\vert}} rac{\partial\sqrt{\vert g\vert}}{\partial au} = abla_\mu J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu \ge 0\); \(\Theta_E \equiv rac{\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}}}{s_0} = - rac{ eta_{\mathrm{th}}}{s_0}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F}\); \(\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \sqrt{ heta^2 + \Theta_E^2}\), \( au_\Theta( au) \equiv \int_{ au_0}^{ au}\langle\Theta_{\mathrm{tot}} angle_{\mathcal{M}}\,d au'\); \( rac{dV_{\mathcal{M}}}{d au} = \int_{\mathcal{M}} heta\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx = \oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\), with \(\lim_{ au o\infty}V_{\mathcal{M}}( au) = V_\infty < \infty\) (Branch II); \( rac{\partial\mathcal{H}}{\partial au} \equiv J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), \(q(\mathbf{x}, au) \equiv -\ln(v_0Q(\mathbf{x}, au))\).
  • Homological Mapping: An association of agents is sustained by throughput: organisms by metabolism, artificial agents by electrical power, and both by a continuing exchange of signals or resources. That throughput corresponds to the throughput rate \(\Theta_E\) of a Branch II state, in which openness is carried by throughput and not by expansion (\( heta o 0\)). The common ground that partners accumulate, the conventions and shared knowledge on which later exchanges rely, grows most where an exchange brings something unexpected. That growth corresponds to the record law \(\partial_ au\mathcal{H} = J_E^\mu abla_\mu q\), as a correspondence between accumulated common ground and the record \(\mathcal{H}\), not an identity.

docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} = p_0\dot{V}_{\mathcal{M}} = p_0\oint_{\partial\mathcal{M}}J_{\mathrm{geom}}^\mu\,d\Sigma_\mu \ge 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} \equiv \int_{\mathcal{M}}(-J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F})\sqrt{\vert g\vert}\,d^nx > 0\); \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{tot}} \equiv \dot{W}_{\mathrm{ext}} + \dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\); \( abla_\mu\mathcal{F} eq 0\); \(J_E^\mu \equiv rac{J_W^\mu}{p_0} = - rac{1}{p_0}\mathfrak{K}^{\mu u} abla_ u\mathcal{F}\) (Branch II, fixed); \(J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} < 0\); \(\dot{s}_{\mathrm{prod}} = - eta_{\mathrm{th}}J_E^\mu abla_\mu\mathcal{F} > 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: Every physical exchange of signals dissipates energy, and erasing information has a minimum thermodynamic cost; a coupled association therefore corresponds to the dissipative power \(\dot{W}_{\mathrm{diss}} > 0\) and to positive entropy production. The potentials that drive signal currents in conductors are electrical potentials in volts, which are not energy densities and are never \(\mathcal{F}\). No flux prediction is made.

docs.text:
• Spine Equations: \(g_{\mu u}( au, \mathbf{x}) = \Omega^2( au, \mathbf{x})\hat{g}_{\mu\alpha}(\mathbf{x})(\exp\hat{h}( au, \mathbf{x}))^\alpha_{\; u}\) with \(\det\hat{g} = 1\), \(\mathrm{Tr}(\hat{h}) = 0 \implies \det g = \Omega^{2n}\), \( rac{\partial\ln\Omega}{\partial au} = rac{1}{n} heta\); \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\); \(G_{\mu u} = \kappa_G T_{\mu u}^{\mathrm{mat}}\), \(R = \kappa_G abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha\); \( rac{2(n-1)}{n} abla^2 heta + rac{2R}{n} heta = -\kappa_G rac{\partial( abla_\alpha\xi^\alpha)}{\partial au} + 2 abla^\alpha abla^ eta\sigma_{\alpha eta} - 2\sigma^{\alpha eta}R_{\alpha eta}\); \(\left.\left( rac{dv^\mu}{d au} + \Gamma^\mu_{ ho\epsilon}v^ ho v^\epsilon + g^{\mu\lambda}\left( rac{\partial g_{\lambda u}}{\partial au} ight)v^ u - rac{1}{2}\left( rac{\partial g_{ ho\epsilon}}{\partial au}v^ ho v^\epsilon ight)v^\mu ight) ight\vert_{N=1,\, eta^\mu=0} = f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}}\), \(f^\mu_{\mathrm{drive}} = (1-u^2)\left(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} - c_*^{-2}(g_{\alpha eta}a^\alpha_{\mathrm{d}}v^ eta)v^\mu ight)\), \(u^2 = g_{\mu u}v^\mu v^ u/c_*^2 < 1\), with the default \(a^\mu_{\mathrm{d}} = 0\).
  • Homological Mapping: An association has a size (the number of its members and the resources they hold) and a shape (the pattern of who exchanges with whom). That separation corresponds to the Weyl split of the volume factor \(\Omega\) from the unimodular shape \(\hat{h}\), and the traced elliptic \( au\)-compatibility equation keeps the two coupled (r10 Decision 2), as a growing association also changes its pattern of exchange. The strength with which an agent holds to its own course of action against deviation corresponds to the precision Hessian \(\Pi_{\mu u} = abla_\mu abla_ u\Phi\), as a correspondence between roles.
